# Test fixtures

- **modem_testrun.pcap** — 5.5 MB pcapng, UERANSIM + Open5GS control-plane capture
  (SCTP/NGAP on port 38412). Source: [theodorsm/5G-testbed](https://github.com/theodorsm/5G-testbed),
  `PoC/results/final_modem_testrun.pcap` (MIT License). 36 UE flows of
  registration/authentication cycles; NAS goes security-protected after the first
  exchange.
- **5g_signaling_example.pcap** — 32 MB, Open5GS+UERANSIM signaling stress run.
  Source: [Zenodo 19605370](https://zenodo.org/records/19605370), `example.pcap.gz`.
  Plaintext NAS registration rejects; attach KPIs from NAS-level pairing.
- **scenario1.pcap** — 3.4 KB, successful registration + PDU session establishment
  (NAS terminal outcomes protected; NGAP-milestone pairing). Source: UERANSIM
  issue [#316](https://github.com/aligungr/UERANSIM/issues/316) attachment
  (UERANSIM, AGPL-3.0).
- **synthetic.pcap** — generated by `tests/synth.py`: one deterministic flow with
  a 100 ms registration (accept), a 50 ms PDU session establishment (accept), a
  30 ms registration (reject), and one retransmitted chunk. Used by the KPI tests.
